heading: EXT. FLOATING MARKET ABOVE THE CLOUDS - DAWN

units.text: EXT. FLOATING MARKET ABOVE THE CLOUDS - DAWN
A cluster of rope-slung gondolas drifts on a sea of cloud.
Lanterns bob.
Between two of them, a plank bridge sways in the wind.
The sun rises like a coin.
CALLISTA WREN (40s, sky-pirate captain, sheepskin coat, one glove missing) stands braced at a railing with a spyglass.
Behind her, ROOK (teen, deckhand, rope-burned palms) coils line.
Captain, the Duskmaw is two points off the port bow.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: I see her, Rook.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: She's turning.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: They always turn at dawn. It's the only time the clouds agree.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: She lowers the glass.
Rook comes to the rail.
Together they watch a black-sailed ship unfurl like a bat through the mist.
We could run.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: We could.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Will we?
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Rook, have you ever known me to run?
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Once.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: That wasn't running. That was a tactical re-evaluation.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Rook grins.
Callista takes his shoulder and steers him toward the helm.
The ropes sing in the wind.
Hard to starboard. Let her come close. Then drop the ballast.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: All of it?
units.name: ROOK

units.text: All of it.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Captain, that's the cargo.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: That's the idea.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: He swallows.
Then runs for the lever, laughing, as the Duskmaw looms.
